arguments.body:
Subject: Incident Report: INC-4091 - Redis Cache Cluster Memory Exhaustion

Dear Executives,

This email is to provide a status update regarding incident INC-4091, which affected the Checkout-Payment-Gateway service.

Incident Details:
- Incident ID: INC-4091
- Title: Redis Cache Cluster Memory Exhaustion
- Severity: P1 - CRITICAL
- Root Cause: Unbounded cache key TTL in the SessionStore service, which resulted in 99.8% RAM saturation.

Current Status:
The incident has been mitigated. Our engineering team performed a manual key eviction, which successfully stabilized the memory usage at 41%. We are currently monitoring the system to ensure stability and are working on a permanent fix to address the TTL configuration.

We will provide further updates as necessary.

Best regards,
Incident Response Team
